tasks.description: Measure bge-embed throughput (chunks/s) against the cluster. ENV=<env>
Start the local LLM proxy (scripts/llm-proxy, Port 18235) detached with PID/log file
cmds_summary:
bash -c '
  set -e
  DIR="$HOME/.local/state/llm-proxy"; mkdir -p "$DIR"
  PIDF="$DIR/proxy.pid"; LOGF="$DIR/proxy.log"
  PORT="${LLM_PROXY_PORT:-18235}"
  if [ -f "$PIDF" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDF")" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "llm-proxy already running (pid $(cat "$PIDF"))"; exit 0
  fi
  # T002277: das PID-File kennt nur die nohup-Instanz. Haelt der devmesh-Forward
  # (devmesh-forward.service, T900191) den Port, ist er belegt, aber
  # kein PID-File da - der Start unten wuerde mit EADDRINUSE sterben und ein
  # PID-File hinterlassen, das auf einen toten Prozess zeigt. Der Port ist
  # die verlaessliche Auskunft, nicht das PID-File.
  # /livez, NICHT /health (T002336): hier geht es um Port-Belegung, nicht
  # um Bedienbarkeit. /health antwortet 503, sobald ein Prio-1-Backend
  # fehlt - mit `curl -fsS` sieht das aus wie "niemand da", und der Start
  # unten liefe in genau das EADDRINUSE, das dieser Block verhindern soll.
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/livez" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "llm-proxy already answering on :$PORT (devmesh-forward? -> systemctl --user status devmesh-forward)"
    exit 0
  fi
  nohup node scripts/llm-proxy/server.mjs >> "$LOGF" 2>&1 &
  echo $! > "$PIDF"
  echo "✓ llm-proxy started (pid $(cat "$PIDF"), log $LOGF)"
'

tasks.description: Show LLM proxy health + discovered backends/models
cmds_summary:
PORT="${LLM_PROXY_PORT:-18235}"
# Erreichbarkeit via /livez (T002336) - sonst meldet der Status "offline",
# waehrend der Proxy laeuft und nur ein Backend fehlt. /health kommt danach
# als eigene Zeile dazu: sie ist die interessante Auskunft, wenn er lebt.
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/livez" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "── Listeners ──"
  echo "Loopback: 127.0.0.1:$PORT"
  BRIDGE_IP=$(docker network inspect "${LLM_PROXY_K3D_NETWORK:-}" -f '{{range .IPAM.Config}}{{.Gateway}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$BRIDGE_IP" ]; then
    echo "Bridge:   $BRIDGE_IP:$PORT (requires bearer token)"
  else
    echo "Bridge:   closed (k3d network not discovered)"
  fi
  echo "── Health & State ──"
  curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health" | jq '{ready, degraded}'
  curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/admin/state" | jq .
else
  echo "llm-proxy offline — Start: task llm:proxy:start"
fi

cmds_summary:
# T002628 GPU-Arbitrierung: Trainings-Vorrang. acquire drainiert die lokalen
# Backends (Auslaufen abwarten, chat-gpu-Loadouts stoppen) und misst das freie
# VRAM. Der Lock wird per trap freigegeben — auch wenn train.py abbricht.
# Nach der Freigabe werden die gestoppten Loadouts wieder gestartet.
#
# LOCKED unterscheidet "wir halten den Lock" von "Lock existiert": nur wer
# acquire erfolgreich abgeschlossen hat, darf release ausfuehren. Schlaegt
# acquire fehl (fremder Lock gehalten oder VRAM unzureichend), stoppt das
# Training — ohne den fremden Lock anzufassen oder fremde Loadouts zu starten.
LOCK_SCRIPT="scripts/gpu-lock.sh"
STOPPED=""
LOCKED=""
trap 'T=$?; if [ -n "$LOCKED" ]; then bash "$LOCK_SCRIPT" release >&2 || true; fi; for slug in $STOPPED; do curl -sf -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18235/admin/loadouts/${slug}/start" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; exit $T' EXIT

if [ -n "${GPU_LOCK_REQUIRED_MIB:-}" ]; then
  bash "$LOCK_SCRIPT" acquire || { echo "[finetune] GPU-Arbitrierung fehlgeschlagen — Training wird NICHT gestartet." >&2; exit 3; }
  LOCKED=1
  STOPPED=$(python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("scripts/llm/loadouts.json")); print(" ".join(l["slug"] for l in d.get("loadouts", []) if l.get("exclusiveGroup")=="chat-gpu" and l.get("managed")!="external"))')
else
  echo "[finetune] GPU_LOCK_REQUIRED_MIB nicht gesetzt — Training ohne GPU-Arbitrierung."
fi

  # Preflight (OPTIONS) is tokenless by design — the proxy answers it without auth.
  preflight=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X OPTIONS http://127.0.0.1:18082/mcp \
    -H "Origin: http://localhost:8098" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" \
    -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type" || echo "000")

  auth=()

  init=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18082/mcp \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
    -H "Origin: http://localhost:8098" \

import json, os, sys

repo_path, claude_home = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

def load_json(path):
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {}

repo = load_json(repo_path)
repo_enabled = [k for k, v in (repo.get("enabledPlugins") or {}).items() if v is True]

installed_doc = load_json(os.path.join(claude_home, "plugins", "installed_plugins.json"))
installed = (installed_doc.get("plugins") or {}) if isinstance(installed_doc, dict) else {}

for p in repo_enabled:

PY
)"

# corrupting the marketplace part of the plugin arg passed to
# `claude plugin install` below. Strip it explicitly rather than
# relying on `read` (which only trims the trailing LF).
MISSING="$(printf '%s' "$MISSING_RAW" | tr -d '\015')"

  echo "agents:plugins:sync: keine fehlenden Plugins -- sauber."
  exit 0
fi

ctx_flag=""

NS="${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}"

# T002292: Der port-forward auf shared-db reisst reproduzierbar ab. Der
# Indexer bricht deshalb jetzt hart ab statt still weiterzuskippen —
# hier wird er so oft neu gestartet, bis er durchlaeuft. Das traegt,
# weil der Hash-Skip in indexFile() Laeufe resumierbar macht: ein
# abgebrochener Pass hinterlaesst einen konsistenten Teil-Index.
# Jeder Pass bekommt einen EIGENEN Port — kein `fuser -k`, das wuerde
# die eigene Prozessgruppe (und damit diese Shell) mit abschiessen.
rc=1
for pass in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  port=$((15434 + pass))
  kubectl $ctx_flag -n "$NS" port-forward svc/shared-db ${port}:5432 \
    >/tmp/scs-index-pf.log 2>&1 &
  pf=$!
  sleep 4
  if ! nc -z 127.0.0.1 $port 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "→ Pass $pass: port-forward kam nicht hoch, neuer Versuch" >&2
    cat /tmp/scs-index-pf.log >&2
    kill $pf 2>/dev/null || true
    continue
  fi
  # `|| rc=$?` ist Pflicht: go-task fuehrt jeden cmds-Block mit
  # set -e-Semantik aus. Ohne das `||` bricht die Shell beim ersten
  # fehlschlagenden Lauf ab — noch BEVOR `rc=$?` gelesen wird — und die
  # Retry-Schleife kommt nie zum Zug (beobachtet 2026-07-27: Pass 1
  # endete mit Exit 1, es folgte kein zweiter Pass).
  rc=0
  PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=$port PGDATABASE=website PGUSER=website \
    npx tsx scripts/index-repo.ts || rc=$?
  kill $pf 2>/dev/null || true
  [ $rc -eq 0 ] && break
  echo "→ Pass $pass endete mit Exit $rc, setze fort" >&2
done
exit $rc

tasks.description: Run the offline-safe spec bats (tests/spec/, rekursiv). Builds mcp-task-runner fresh if go is available (best-effort). Live-DB cases skip without a reachable cluster, so this is CI-safe. SPEC_SHARD/SPEC_SHARDS laeuft nur die eigene Partition (siehe scripts/spec-shard.sh).
cmds_summary:
# `find` statt `bats -r tests/spec/` [T002500]: die Shard-Aufteilung braucht eine
# explizite Dateiliste. Der rekursive Fang bleibt identisch zu `-r` — und damit
# auch die Eigenschaft aus T002416, dass Tests unter tests/spec/<spec-slug>/
# miterfasst werden. Ein flacher Glob wuerde sie stillschweigend auslassen, was
# schlimmer waere als ein roter Test.
FILES=$(find tests/spec -name '*.bats' -type f | LC_ALL=C sort)
if [ "${SPEC_SHARDS:-1}" -gt 1 ]; then
  # [T004024] Seed aus HEAD-SHA: alle Matrix-Legs desselben Commits
  # partitionieren identisch, aber die schwerste Datei rotiert je nach
  # Commit ueber die Shards (statt immer auf Shard 1 zu landen).
  SPEC_SHARD_SEED="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12 || true)"
  FILES=$(printf '%s\n' "$FILES" | bash scripts/spec-shard.sh --shard "${SPEC_SHARD:?SPEC_SHARD fehlt}" --of "$SPEC_SHARDS" --seed "${SPEC_SHARD_SEED:-}")
  echo "→ Shard ${SPEC_SHARD}/${SPEC_SHARDS}: $(printf '%s' "$FILES" | grep -c .) Dateien"
fi
# Leere Auswahl ist ein Fehler, kein No-op. Ein still gruener Leerlauf saehe
# aus wie eine bestandene Suite, obwohl nichts lief — genau die Klasse von
# Fehler, die das Sharding einfuehren kann und die niemand bemerkt.
if [ "$(printf '%s' "$FILES" | grep -c .)" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "test:spec: FEHLER — keine Spec-Dateien ausgewaehlt" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# [T002779] spec-tracked-file-guard: Snapshot vor bats nehmen,
# nicht am Task-Anfang — test:spec:build-mcp-runner laeuft vorher
# und erzeugt legitime Ausgabe.
GUARD_SNAP="$(mktemp)"
bash scripts/spec-tracked-file-guard.sh snapshot "$GUARD_SNAP"

# [T003025] BATS_JUNIT_DIR schaltet den junit-Report an (CI laedt ihn als
# Artifakt hoch, scripts/spec-junit-weights.sh macht daraus die
# Laufzeit-Gewichte fuer spec-shard.sh). Ohne die Variable: exakt wie vorher.
BATS_EXTRA_ARGS=()
if [ -n "${BATS_JUNIT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$BATS_JUNIT_DIR"
  BATS_EXTRA_ARGS+=(--report-formatter junit -o "$BATS_JUNIT_DIR")
fi

set +e
bash scripts/lib/run-bats.sh -j $(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2) --no-parallelize-within-files "${BATS_EXTRA_ARGS[@]}" $FILES
BATS_STATUS=$?
bash scripts/spec-tracked-file-guard.sh verify "$GUARD_SNAP"
GUARD_STATUS=$?
set -e

rm -f "$GUARD_SNAP"
if [ "$BATS_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$BATS_STATUS"; fi
# [T002779] Guard ist bei der initialen Ausrollung nicht-fatal:
# bestehende Spec-Tests (z.B. agent-roster P4.5: task agent-guide:maps)
# regenerieren getrackte Dateien; ihre Behebung ist ein eigener Vorgang.
# Sobald alle Fundstellen behoben sind, wird exit "$GUARD_STATUS" aktiv.
if [ "$GUARD_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "⚠ spec-tracked-file-guard: getrackte Datei(en) waehrend des Spec-Laufs beruehrt — Befund, kein CI-Blocker [T002779]" >&2
fi
exit 0

tasks.description: Run the full offline-safe spec suite and write tests/spec/.spec-runtime.tsv (measured seconds per file) — the runtime weights for spec-shard.sh. [T003025] Am besten auf einem CI-gleichen Host (kein Live-Cluster/keine DB), damit die Gewichte die CI-Realitaet abbilden. CI-Alternative: junit-Artifakte aus ci.yml herunterladen und scripts/spec-junit-weights.sh darauf laufen lassen.
cmds_summary:
FILES=$(find tests/spec -name '*.bats' -type f | LC_ALL=C sort)
if [ "$(printf '%s' "$FILES" | grep -c .)" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "test:spec:timing: FEHLER — keine Spec-Dateien gefunden" >&2
  exit 1
fi
REPORT_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
echo "→ Full spec suite mit junit-Report ($(printf '%s' "$FILES" | grep -c .) Dateien) — kann >10 min dauern"
set +e
bash tests/bats -j $(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2) --no-parallelize-within-files --report-formatter junit -o "$REPORT_DIR" $FILES
BATS_STATUS=$?
set -e
bash scripts/spec-junit-weights.sh "$REPORT_DIR"/report.xml --to tests/spec/.spec-runtime.tsv
rm -rf "$REPORT_DIR"
if [ "$BATS_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$BATS_STATUS"; fi
echo "→ tests/spec/.spec-runtime.tsv geschrieben — Balance pruefen:"
find tests/spec -name '*.bats' -type f | bash scripts/spec-shard.sh --verify --of 4 | tail -8
exit 0

tasks.description: Run only the spec bats matching the files changed vs origin/main (scripts/find-changed-tests.sh spec). Falls back to the full suite when a shared harness/workflow/Taskfile changed. [T002245]
cmds_summary:
CHANGED_FILES=$(bash scripts/find-changed-tests.sh spec)
# [T003056] Ab hier ist die Variable verbraucht: sie steuert AUSSCHLIESSLICH
# die Auswahl oben. Bliebe sie in der Umgebung, erbte sie jeder von bats
# gestartete Test — und Tests, die find-changed-tests.sh in einem eigenen
# tmp-Repo gegen dessen Default-Diff pruefen, bekaemen stattdessen den
# override-Zweig mit den Dateien des aeusseren Repos. Genau das machte auf
# main sechs Guards rot (T002245/T002345/T002377), waehrend sie lokal und
# auf PRs gruen blieben: nur auf main setzt ci.yml die Variable.
unset FIND_CHANGED_TESTS_FILES
if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
  echo "→ No matching spec tests for this diff"
  exit 0
fi
# [T002377] Anzahl nennen und den Vollauf benennen. Ohne das las sich der
# stille RUN_ALL-Fallback wie eine gezielte Auswahl; der Lauf dauert dann
# aber ueber zehn Minuten, und ein Timeout darauf sieht aus wie ein
# Testfehler ("exit 1, obwohl alle Untertests gruen").
SELECTED=$(echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | wc -l)
# find statt ls-Glob [T002416]: der Glob zaehlt nur die oberste Ebene. Zu kleines
# TOTAL laesst SELECTED >= TOTAL werden und meldet faelschlich "FULL spec suite".
TOTAL=$(find tests/spec -name '*.bats' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
if [ "$SELECTED" -ge "$TOTAL" ]; then
  echo "→ FULL spec suite ($SELECTED files) — diff-scoped selection fell back to run-all; expect >10 min"
else
  echo "→ Running changed spec tests ($SELECTED of $TOTAL):"
fi
echo "$CHANGED_FILES"
# [T002500] Sharding auch hier, denn der teure Fall laeuft ueber DIESEN Pfad:
# aendert ein PR ci.yml/Taskfile.yml oder ein geteiltes Harness, faellt
# find-changed-tests.sh fail-closed auf die volle Suite zurueck (~400s).
if [ "${SPEC_SHARDS:-1}" -gt 1 ]; then
  # [T004024] Seed wie in test:spec — gleicher Commit, gleiche Partition;
  # die schwerste geaenderte Datei rotiert ueber die Shards.
  SPEC_SHARD_SEED="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12 || true)"
  CHANGED_FILES=$(printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED_FILES" | bash scripts/spec-shard.sh --shard "${SPEC_SHARD:?SPEC_SHARD fehlt}" --of "$SPEC_SHARDS" --seed "${SPEC_SHARD_SEED:-}")
  # Anders als bei test:spec ist ein leerer Shard hier legitim: eine
  # diff-gescopte Auswahl kann weniger Dateien haben als es Shards gibt.
  if [ "$(printf '%s' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -c .)" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "→ Shard ${SPEC_SHARD}/${SPEC_SHARDS}: keine Dateien in dieser Partition"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "→ Shard ${SPEC_SHARD}/${SPEC_SHARDS}: $(printf '%s' "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -c .) Dateien"
fi
# [T002779] spec-tracked-file-guard: Snapshot vor bats nehmen.
GUARD_SNAP="$(mktemp)"
bash scripts/spec-tracked-file-guard.sh snapshot "$GUARD_SNAP"

# [T003025] junit-Report wie in test:spec (siehe dort).
BATS_EXTRA_ARGS=()
if [ -n "${BATS_JUNIT_DIR:-}" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$BATS_JUNIT_DIR"
  BATS_EXTRA_ARGS+=(--report-formatter junit -o "$BATS_JUNIT_DIR")
fi

set +e
bash tests/bats -j $(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2) --no-parallelize-within-files "${BATS_EXTRA_ARGS[@]}" $CHANGED_FILES
BATS_STATUS=$?
bash scripts/spec-tracked-file-guard.sh verify "$GUARD_SNAP"
GUARD_STATUS=$?
set -e

rm -f "$GUARD_SNAP"
if [ "$BATS_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$BATS_STATUS"; fi
# [T002779] Guard nicht-fatal waehrend der initialen Ausrollung (siehe test:spec).
if [ "$GUARD_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "⚠ spec-tracked-file-guard: getrackte Datei(en) waehrend des Spec-Laufs beruehrt — Befund, kein CI-Blocker [T002779]" >&2
fi
exit 0

if [ "$RUN_WEBSITE" = "true" ]; then

fi
if [ "$RUN_MENTOLDER_WEB" = "true" ]; then
  if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 && (cd components/website && pnpm vitest --version </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1); then
    echo "→ mentolder-web changes: pnpm --filter mentolder-web test"
    pnpm --filter mentolder-web test
  else

  fi
fi
if [ "$RUN_K8S" = "true" ]; then echo "→ k8s changes: task test:manifests"; task test:manifests; fi

# Laufzeit-Drift-Guard (T003825): meldet DB-Funktionen/MCP-Binaries, die

bash scripts/runtime-drift-check.sh

JOBS=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 2)

fi

if [ "$RUN_SPEC" = "true" ]; then

    bash tests/bats -j $JOBS --no-parallelize-within-files $CHANGED_FILES

if [ "$RUN_FACTORY" = "true" ]; then echo "→ FA changes: task test:decommission"; task test:decommission; fi
if [ "$RUN_MCP" = "true" ] && [ "$RUN_SCRIPTS" = "false" ] && [ "$RUN_UNIT" = "false" ]; then echo "→ MCP tooling guardrail"; task test:mcp-tooling; fi

  else
    echo "→ e2e website uebersprungen: localhost:4321 antwortet nicht. Kein PR-Blocker — CI fuehrt diese Gruppe fuer PRs ohnehin nicht aus."
  fi
fi

# k3d/-Aenderung lief sie bisher bedingungslos und schlug ohne Dev-Stack mit 13

  if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 && (cd components/website && pnpm vitest --version </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1); then

# Dev-only: apply plaintext dev secrets (prod uses SealedSecrets — never overwrite).
# T001853: these manifests now parameterize namespace: ${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE}
# (was hardcoded to "website", breaking on korczewski dev where the website
# namespace differs) — must flow through envsubst before apply.
if [ "{{.ENV}}" = "dev" ]; then
  envsubst "\$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/website-dev-secrets.yaml | kubectl ${CTX_ARG} apply -f -
  # T001490 Task 9 — content-publish bot token placeholder
  envsubst "\$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/website-content-token-secret.yaml | kubectl ${CTX_ARG} apply -f -
  # T001853: domain-config ConfigMap was never applied to the website ns in
  # dev, causing "domain-config not found" on the website pod.
  kubectl ${CTX_ARG} -n "${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE}" apply -f k3d/configmap-domains.yaml
fi

# Only pin to digest on pure-amd64 clusters; mixed-arch clusters (e.g. korczewski
# has both amd64 and arm64 nodes) need the multi-arch :latest tag because the
# push digest only covers the amd64 manifest, not the manifest list.
HAS_ARM=$(kubectl ${CTX_ARG} get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.status.nodeInfo.architecture}{"\n"}{end}' 2>/dev/null | grep -c arm64 || true)
if [ -n "${DIGEST}" ] && [ "${HAS_ARM}" = "0" ]; then
  echo "Pinning deployment to ${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}..."
  kubectl ${CTX_ARG} -n "${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE}" set image deployment/website "website=${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}"
elif [ -n "${DIGEST}" ]; then
  # Without a digest pin the Deployment spec is unchanged, so `apply` is a
  # no-op and the pod keeps its cached :latest image. Force a rollout so
  # imagePullPolicy:Always actually pulls the freshly-pushed tag.
  echo "Mixed-arch cluster detected — forcing rollout to pick up :latest"
  kubectl ${CTX_ARG} -n "${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE}" rollout restart deployment/website
fi

# TLS/middlewares are applied from the prod-fleet/website-<brand>/ overlay
# (now wired into this task above), not imperative patches:
# - mentolder: website-ingress-web Ingress (workspace-wildcard-tls + middlewares)
# - korczewski: IngressRoute TLS patch (korczewski-tls + websecure) + security-headers
# Removed blanket certResolver:letsencrypt patch that broke korczewski (T000147).

echo "Waiting for website..."
kubectl ${CTX_ARG} -n "${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE}" rollout status deployment/website --timeout=180s
set -euo pipefail
source scripts/env-resolve.sh "{{.ENV}}"
if [ "{{.ENV}}" = "dev" ]; then
  SMOKE_URL="http://web.localhost/404"
else
  SMOKE_URL="https://web.${PROD_DOMAIN}/404"
fi
echo ""
echo "Smoke check: ${SMOKE_URL} must not redirect to itself (would cause ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS)..."
HEADERS=$(curl -sS -I --max-redirs 0 --max-time 15 "${SMOKE_URL}" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "${HEADERS}" ]; then
  echo "⚠ Smoke check skipped — ${SMOKE_URL} not reachable from this host."
else
  STATUS=$(printf '%s\n' "${HEADERS}" | awk 'NR==1{print $2}')
  LOCATION=$(printf '%s\n' "${HEADERS}" | awk 'tolower($1)=="location:"{print $2; exit}' | tr -d '\r')
  case "${STATUS}" in
    200|404)
      echo "✓ /404 returns HTTP ${STATUS} (no redirect loop)"
      ;;
    30[12378])
      if printf '%s' "${LOCATION}" | grep -qE '(^|/)404/?$'; then
        echo "✗ /404 redirects to itself (${STATUS} → ${LOCATION}). ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS regression."
        echo "  Ensure components/website/src/pages/404.astro exists so Astro serves a static 404 page."
        exit 1
      fi
      echo "⚠ /404 responded ${STATUS} → ${LOCATION} (unexpected but not a self-loop)"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "⚠ /404 returned HTTP '${STATUS:-<empty>}' — expected 200/404. Not failing deploy."
      ;;
  esac
fi
echo ""

tasks.description: Run Astro dev server locally (hot-reload)
Serve SDLC Cockpit static files locally (http://localhost:8765)
Start the SDLC Cockpit daemon in the background and wait until it answers (PORT= to override)
cmds_summary:
set -eu
PORT="{{.PORT}}"
LOG="${COCKPIT_DAEMON_LOG:-/tmp/cockpit-daemon.log}"

if curl -sf -m 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "cockpit:daemon: bereits erreichbar auf Port ${PORT}"
  exit 0
fi

# setsid ist nicht optional: go-task raeumt beim Task-Ende die eigene
# Prozessgruppe ab. Ein einfaches `cmd &` wuerde den Daemon zusammen mit
# diesem Task beenden — er startet, schreibt sein Log und ist wieder weg.
# Der Daemon muss eine eigene Session bekommen, um den Task zu ueberleben.
#
# Bewusst der direkte Binary-Aufruf statt `npx tsx`: npx schiebt einen
# Wrapper-Prozess dazwischen, dessen PID nicht die des Daemons ist.
rm -f /tmp/cockpit-daemon.pid
COCKPIT_DAEMON_PORT="${PORT}" setsid ./node_modules/.bin/tsx .lavish/kit/daemon/server.ts >"${LOG}" 2>&1 &

for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf -m 1 "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "cockpit:daemon: bereit auf http://127.0.0.1:${PORT} (pid $(cat /tmp/cockpit-daemon.pid 2>/dev/null || echo '?'))"
    echo "cockpit:daemon: stoppen mit  kill \$(cat /tmp/cockpit-daemon.pid)"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 0.25
done

echo "cockpit:daemon: FEHLER — /health auf Port ${PORT} antwortet nach 15s nicht" >&2
cat "${LOG}" >&2
if [ -f /tmp/cockpit-daemon.pid ]; then
  kill "$(cat /tmp/cockpit-daemon.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
exit 1

    export COLLABORA_INGRESS_MIDDLEWARES="${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}-redirect-https@kubernetescrd,${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}-hsts-headers@kubernetescrd"

Pre-deploy checklist — secrets, SealedSecrets, overlay, cluster health (ENV=dev|mentolder|korczewski)
Deploy workspace to any environment (ENV=dev|mentolder|korczewski|...)
cmds_summary:
# ⚠️ DEPRECATED: Direct push-based workspace:deploy is deprecated under FluxCD GitOps.
# Pull-based reconciliation via Flux is the primary deployment path on fleet.
# Direct workspace:deploy is retained for Break-Glass use. Before using Break-Glass
# imperative deploys, suspend Flux reconciliation via: `flux suspend kustomization <name>`.
source scripts/env-resolve.sh "{{.ENV}}"

if [ "{{.ENV}}" != "dev" ]; then
  active_ctx=$(kubectl config current-context 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ "$active_ctx" != "$ENV_CONTEXT" ]; then
    echo "Switching kubectl context: $active_ctx → $ENV_CONTEXT"
    kubectl config use-context "$ENV_CONTEXT"
  fi
fi

if [ "{{.ENV}}" = "dev" ]; then
  # Deploy shared-db prerequisites + shared-db first so dependent services don't crash-loop
  kubectl apply -f k3d/namespace.yaml
  if ! kubectl get namespace "${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE:-website}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    kubectl create namespace "${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE:-website}"
  fi
  kubectl apply -f k3d/secrets.yaml -n workspace
  kubectl apply -f k3d/configmap-domains.yaml -n workspace
  kubectl apply -f k3d/website-schema.yaml -n workspace
  # $$ -> $ Collapse wie im kustomize-Hauptpfad: shared-db.yaml traegt $$-escapte
  # Shell-Vars; roh applied setzt der postStart-Hook sonst alle DB-Passwoerter
  # auf '<PID>{VAR}' (Incident T001673).
  sed -E 's/\$\$([a-zA-Z0-9_({!?])/$\1/g' k3d/shared-db.yaml \
    | kubectl apply -n workspace -f -
  echo "Waiting for shared-db to be ready before deploying dependent services..."
  kubectl rollout status deployment/shared-db -n workspace --timeout=120s
  # Run website DB migrations before the website Deployment is rolled
  # out below (T001652 — website had no automated migration runner).
  task website:migrate ENV="{{.ENV}}"
  task db:migrate ENV="{{.ENV}}"
  # Full apply (idempotent — updates configs, adds remaining services)
  # SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED defaults to "false" so the placeholder is
  # never emitted literally in dev (where the env file may omit it).
  # POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS: von SMTP_SECURE + SMTP_PORT hergeleitet (Pocket-ID kennt kein
  # SMTP_SECURE-Bool, sondern SMTP_TLS=none|starttls|tls). secure=true -> implizites TLS
  # (z.B. Port 465); Port 587 ist bei allen aktuell konfigurierten Envs (mentolder,
  # korczewski, staging) STARTTLS gegen mailbox.org; alles andere (z.B. Mailpit dev auf
  # Port 1025) bleibt unverschluesselt.
  if [ "${SMTP_SECURE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
    export POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS="tls"
  elif [ "${SMTP_PORT:-}" = "587" ]; then
    export POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS="starttls"
  else
    export POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS="none"
  fi
  SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED="${SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED:-false}" \
  LLM_ENABLED="${LLM_ENABLED:-false}" \
  LLM_RERANK_ENABLED="${LLM_RERANK_ENABLED:-false}" \
  LLM_HOST_IP="${LLM_HOST_IP:-172.17.0.1}" \
  LLM_ROUTER_URL="${LLM_ROUTER_URL:-http://llm-gateway-lmstudio.workspace.svc.cluster.local:1234}" \
  LLM_EMBED_URL="${LLM_EMBED_URL:-http://llm-gateway-embed.workspace.svc.cluster.local:8081}" \
  LLM_RERANKER_URL="${LLM_RERANKER_URL:-http://llm-gateway-rerank.workspace.svc.cluster.local:8081}" \
  POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL="${POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL:-http://id.localhost}" \
  POCKET_ID_URL="${POCKET_ID_URL:-http://pocket-id.${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}.svc.cluster.local:1411}" \
  POCKET_ID_DOMAIN="${POCKET_ID_DOMAIN:-id.localhost}" \
  SESSIONS_DOMAIN="${SESSIONS_DOMAIN:-sessions.localhost}" \
    kustomize build k3d/ --load-restrictor=LoadRestrictionsNone \
      | sed -E 's/: \$\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}[[:space:]]*$/: "${\1}"/g' \
      | TURN_OVERLAY_IP="${TURN_OVERLAY_IP:-172.17.0.1}" \
        TERMINAL_OVERLAY_IP="${TERMINAL_OVERLAY_IP:-172.17.0.1}" \
        envsubst "\$PROD_DOMAIN \$BRAND_NAME \$CONTACT_EMAIL \$BACKUP_ALERT_EMAIL \$BRAND_ID \$SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED \$ARENA_WS_URL \$LLM_ENABLED \$LLM_RERANK_ENABLED \$LLM_HOST_IP \$LLM_ROUTER_URL \$LLM_EMBED_URL \$LLM_RERANKER_URL \$STUDIO_IMAGE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE \$SMTP_FROM \$SMTP_HOST \$SMTP_PORT \$SMTP_USER \$POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS \$POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL \$POCKET_ID_URL \$POCKET_ID_DOMAIN \$SESSIONS_DOMAIN \$TURN_OVERLAY_IP \$TERMINAL_OVERLAY_IP" \
      | sed -E 's/\$\$([a-zA-Z0-9_({!?])/$\1/g' \
      | kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f -
  # Tests retention CronJob — applied separately so its Role+RoleBinding
  # can land in WEBSITE_NAMESPACE (kustomize's top-level namespace
  # transformer would otherwise force them into workspace).
  envsubst "\$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/tests-retention-cronjob.yaml | kubectl apply -f -
  envsubst "\$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/cicd-deploy-sa.yaml | kubectl apply -f -
  # Cross-namespace RBAC for pocket-id-client-seed to also patch website-secrets (T001435)
  envsubst "\$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/pocket-id-client-seed-website-rbac.yaml | kubectl apply -f -
  # System-test failure-loop cleanup CronJobs — applied separately so
  # they land in WEBSITE_NAMESPACE alongside the website pod (kustomize's
  # top-level `namespace: workspace` would otherwise force them into the
  # wrong ns). Default WEBSITE_NAMESPACE=website if not set in env file.
  # NOTE: cronjob-systemtest-cleanup.yaml is intentionally empty — the three
  # systemtest CronJobs were removed in T002644 (their /sdlc/ routes no longer
  # exist in prod after the SDLC-split T002624).
else
  # Prod: build from overlay, apply to target cluster
  _ws_ns="${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}"
  _website_ns="${WEBSITE_NAMESPACE:-website}"

  # Apply SealedSecret first so the Secret is ready when pods start
  source scripts/lib/secrets-env.sh   # T900789: mentolder -> fleet-mentolder
  sealed="environments/sealed-secrets/$(secrets_env_for "{{.ENV}}").yaml"
  if [ -f "$sealed" ]; then
    # Pre-create ALL namespaces referenced by SealedSecrets so apply doesn't fail.
    # Includes coturn + workspace-office so their SealedSecrets land cleanly.
    for _ns in "$_ws_ns" cert-manager "$_website_ns" coturn workspace-office monitoring; do
      kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" create namespace "$_ns" \
        --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f -
    done
    # Defense-in-depth (T001404): drop any SealedSecret document whose
    # namespace is in SHARED_NAMESPACES and whose owner-brand
    # annotation does not include the current ENV. Prevents
    # follow-up damage if a SealedSecret file is manually edited or
    # contains legacy-only blocks. Falls back to applying the
    # original file if yq is unavailable.
    if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      _shared_ns_csv=$(IFS=,; echo "${SHARED_NAMESPACES[*]:-rustdesk,coturn}")
      _filtered=$(yq eval-all '
        select(
          .kind != "SealedSecret" or
          (.metadata.namespace as $ns | "'"$_shared_ns_csv"'" | split(",") as $shared |
           ($shared | index($ns)) == null) or
          (.metadata.annotations["secrets.bachelorprojekt/owner-brand"] as $ob |
           $ob == null or ($ob | split("[ ,]" | .[]? // "") | index("'"{{.ENV}}"'")) != null)
        )
      ' "$sealed" 2>/dev/null || cat "$sealed")
      if [[ -n "$_filtered" ]]; then
        _sealed_filtered="$(mktemp)"
        echo "$_filtered" > "$_sealed_filtered"
        trap "rm -f '$_sealed_filtered'" EXIT
        sealed="$_sealed_filtered"
      fi
    fi
    kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f "$sealed"
    if ! bash scripts/wait-for-sealed-secret.sh \
         --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" --namespace "${_ws_ns}" \
         --secret workspace-secrets --timeout 90; then
      echo "Aborting deploy: workspace-secrets is not present — refusing to continue without credentials." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    # Provision ghcr-pull-secret in the workspace namespace so image pulls succeed.
    _ghcr_pat=$(kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" get secret workspace-secrets \
      -n "${_ws_ns}" -o jsonpath='{.data.GHCR_PAT}' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    if [[ -n "$_ghcr_pat" ]]; then
      kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" create secret docker-registry ghcr-pull-secret \
        --namespace="${_ws_ns}" \
        --docker-server=ghcr.io \
        --docker-username=Paddione \
        --docker-password="$_ghcr_pat" \
        --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f -
      echo "✓ ghcr-pull-secret provisioned in ${_ws_ns}"
    fi
  fi

  # Deploy shared-db first (base manifest); full overlay apply below patches it via --server-side --force-conflicts.
  # Apply namespace.yaml labels via a patch so pod-security enforcement is correct on any cluster.
  kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" create namespace "${_ws_ns}" --dry-run=client -o yaml \
    | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f -
  kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" label namespace "${_ws_ns}" \
    "app.kubernetes.io/part-of=workspace-mvp" \
    "pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=privileged" \
    "pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted" \
    --overwrite
  # Apply website-schema ConfigMap first as shared-db expects it for schema init
  kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" -n "${_ws_ns}" apply -f k3d/website-schema.yaml
  # -n "${_ws_ns}" places the namespace-less shared-db Deployment in the
  # target ns. The base manifest intentionally omits namespace on the
  # Deployment so the prod/ strategic-merge patch matches it as [noNs];
  # PVC/ConfigMap/Services keep their explicit (sed-rewritten) namespace.
  # $$ -> $ Collapse wie im kustomize-Hauptpfad (Zeile mit ENVSUBST_VARS unten):
  # ohne ihn landet '$${VAR}' literal im postStart-Hook und die Shell expandiert
  # $$ zur PID — alle DB-User-Passwoerter werden zu '<PID>{VAR}' (Incident T001673).
  sed "s/namespace: workspace$/namespace: ${_ws_ns}/g" k3d/shared-db.yaml \
    | sed -E 's/\$\$([a-zA-Z0-9_({!?])/$\1/g' \
    | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" -n "${_ws_ns}" apply -f -
  echo "Waiting for shared-db to be ready before deploying dependent services..."
  kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" rollout status deployment/shared-db -n "${_ws_ns}" --timeout=120s
  # Run website DB migrations before the website Deployment is rolled
  # out below (T001652 — website had no automated migration runner).
  task website:migrate ENV="{{.ENV}}"
  task db:migrate ENV="{{.ENV}}"

  overlay="${ENV_OVERLAY:-prod}"
  # Derive Nextcloud MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS / MAIL_DOMAIN from the authoritative SMTP_FROM
  # so Nextcloud's sender matches the SMTP-authenticated mailbox (mailbox.org rejects
  # senders the authenticated account does not own with 553).
  export MAIL_FROM_LOCAL="${SMTP_FROM%@*}"
  export MAIL_FROM_DOMAIN="${SMTP_FROM#*@}"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="\$PROD_DOMAIN \$BRAND_NAME \$CONTACT_EMAIL \$BACKUP_ALERT_EMAIL \$INFRA_NAMESPACE \$TLS_SECRET_NAME"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$SMTP_FROM \$SMTP_HOST \$SMTP_PORT \$SMTP_USER \$MAIL_FROM_LOCAL \$MAIL_FROM_DOMAIN \$POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$WEBSITE_IMAGE \$WEBSITE_IMAGE_TAG \$WEBSITE_IMAGE_DIGEST \$BRETT_IMAGE \$BRETT_IMAGE_DIGEST \$TURN_PUBLIC_IP \$TURN_NODE \$TURN_OVERLAY_IP \$TERMINAL_OVERLAY_IP \$BRAND_ID"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$KC_USER1_USERNAME \$KC_USER1_EMAIL \$KC_USER2_USERNAME \$KC_USER2_EMAIL"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$BRETT_DOMAIN \$PENPOT_DOMAIN \$PENPOT_PUBLIC_URI"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$BRAIN_EXTERNAL_URL"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$RECOVER_DOMAIN \$OTEL_DOMAIN"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$STUDIO_DOMAIN \$STUDIO_IMAGE \$STUDIO_IMAGE_DIGEST \$STUDIO_DB_URL \$WHISPER_URL"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED \$SESSIONS_DOMAIN"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$LLM_HOST_IP \$LLM_ENABLED \$LLM_RERANK_ENABLED \$LLM_ROUTER_URL \$LLM_EMBED_URL \$LLM_RERANKER_URL"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$COMFY_HOST_IP \$COMFY_PORT"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$RIGGER_HOST_IP \$RIGGER_PORT"

  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$NTFY_BASE_URL \$AGENT_PUSH_API \$AGENT_PUSH_LINK_BASE"
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$DEV_DOMAIN \$DEV_NODE \$DEV_WEBSITE_HOST \$DEV_BRETT_HOST"
  # Pocket ID (T001068 Welle 0): POCKET_ID_DOMAIN lives in
  # k3d/configmap-domains.yaml (POCKET_ID_DOMAIN: id.localhost in dev,
  # overlay replaces it with id.${PROD_DOMAIN} for prod) — that path is
  # already covered by the strategic-merge patch in prod/configmap-domains.yaml.
  # POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL + POCKET_ID_URL are envsubst targets in
  # k3d/pocket-id.yaml (APP_URL, literal envsubst'd) and the prod patch
  # (id.${PROD_DOMAIN}, https://id.${PROD_DOMAIN}). POCKET_ID_DOMAIN is
  # also referenced from the k3d/pocket-id.yaml IngressRoute
  # (Host(`${POCKET_ID_DOMAIN}`)) — kustomize passes the envsubst list
  # through to it as well.
  # POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS (T001396): abgeleitet aus SMTP_SECURE + SMTP_PORT, siehe
  # Herleitungs-Snippet oben — kein eigenes Schema-Pflichtfeld, da Pocket-ID (anders als
  # Website/Nextcloud) ein Drei-Werte-Enum statt eines Bools erwartet.
  ENVSUBST_VARS="$ENVSUBST_VARS \$POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL \$POCKET_ID_URL \$POCKET_ID_DOMAIN"
  # Pocket ID (T001068 Welle 0): defaults so the prod envsubst list
  # never emits literal ${POCKET_ID_*} tokens when an env file hasn't
  # adopted them yet.
  # POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS: von SMTP_SECURE + SMTP_PORT hergeleitet (Pocket-ID kennt kein
  # SMTP_SECURE-Bool, sondern SMTP_TLS=none|starttls|tls). secure=true -> implizites TLS
  # (z.B. Port 465); Port 587 ist bei allen aktuell konfigurierten Envs (mentolder,
  # korczewski, staging) STARTTLS gegen mailbox.org; alles andere (z.B. Mailpit dev auf
  # Port 1025) bleibt unverschluesselt.
  if [ "${SMTP_SECURE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
    export POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS="tls"
  elif [ "${SMTP_PORT:-}" = "587" ]; then
    export POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS="starttls"
  else
    export POCKET_ID_SMTP_TLS="none"
  fi
  export POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL="${POCKET_ID_FRONTEND_URL:-https://id.${PROD_DOMAIN}}"
  export POCKET_ID_URL="${POCKET_ID_URL:-http://pocket-id.${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}.svc.cluster.local:1411}"
  export POCKET_ID_DOMAIN="${POCKET_ID_DOMAIN:-id.${PROD_DOMAIN}}"
  # RustDesk web-client bridge (T001381): default overlay IP so a brand/dev
  # env that hasn't adopted TURN_OVERLAY_IP still renders a valid Endpoints
  # address instead of the literal ${TURN_OVERLAY_IP} token.
  export TURN_OVERLAY_IP="${TURN_OVERLAY_IP:-127.0.0.1}"
  # Terminal-sidekick (T001565): default overlay IP — see workspace:deploy.
  export TERMINAL_OVERLAY_IP="${TERMINAL_OVERLAY_IP:-127.0.0.1}"
  # Ensure DEV_* defaults exist for non-mentolder envs (korczewski/dev).
  export DEV_DOMAIN="${DEV_DOMAIN:-}"
  export DEV_NODE="${DEV_NODE:-}"
  export DEV_WEBSITE_HOST="${DEV_WEBSITE_HOST:-}"
  export DEV_BRETT_HOST="${DEV_BRETT_HOST:-}"
  # Default to "false" so prod env files that haven't yet adopted
  # the flag don't leak the literal "${SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED}"
  # into the rendered website-config ConfigMap.
  export SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED="${SYSTEMTEST_LOOP_ENABLED:-false}"
  export SESSIONS_DOMAIN="${SESSIONS_DOMAIN:-sessions.localhost}"
  export LLM_HOST_IP="${LLM_HOST_IP:-}"
  export LLM_ENABLED="${LLM_ENABLED:-false}"
  export LLM_RERANK_ENABLED="${LLM_RERANK_ENABLED:-false}"
  export LLM_ROUTER_URL="${LLM_ROUTER_URL:-http://llm-gateway-lmstudio.workspace.svc.cluster.local:1234}"
  export LLM_EMBED_URL="${LLM_EMBED_URL:-http://llm-gateway-embed.workspace.svc.cluster.local:8081}"
  export LLM_RERANKER_URL="${LLM_RERANKER_URL:-http://llm-gateway-rerank.workspace.svc.cluster.local:8081}"
  export COMFY_HOST_IP="${COMFY_HOST_IP:-}"
  export COMFY_PORT="${COMFY_PORT:-}"
  export RIGGER_HOST_IP="${RIGGER_HOST_IP:-${COMFY_HOST_IP:-}}"
  export RIGGER_PORT="${RIGGER_PORT:-8190}"
  # Delete immutable Jobs before re-apply so field changes don't cause
  # "field is immutable" errors (Jobs cannot be patched in-place).
  kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" -n "$_ws_ns" delete job pocket-id-client-seed --ignore-not-found=true
  # T900029: Render-Guard (fail-closed) — leere Wildcard-Reste ("*.")
  # und unsubstituierte ${VAR} in dnsNames/Host-Zeilen brechen den
  # Deploy ab, BEVOR kubectl etwas appliziert. Temp-Datei statt Pipe,
  # damit bei Guard-Fehler kein Teil-Manifest appliziert wird; das
  # explizite "|| exit 1" gilt unabhaengig von den Shell-Flags des Tasks.
  _guard_tmp="$(mktemp)"
  kustomize build "$overlay/" --load-restrictor=LoadRestrictionsNone \
    | sed -E 's/: \$\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}[[:space:]]*$/: "${\1}"/g' \
    | envsubst "$ENVSUBST_VARS" \
    | sed -E 's/\$\$([a-zA-Z0-9_({!?])/$\1/g' \
    > "$_guard_tmp"
  bash scripts/render-guard.sh "$_guard_tmp" || exit 1
  cat "$_guard_tmp" \
    | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply --server-side --force-conflicts -f -
  rm -f "$_guard_tmp"
  # Tests retention CronJob — applied separately so its Role+RoleBinding
  # can land in WEBSITE_NAMESPACE (kustomize's top-level namespace
  # transformer would otherwise force them into the workspace ns,
  # where the website pod does NOT live).
  envsubst "\$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/tests-retention-cronjob.yaml \
    | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f -
  envsubst "\$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/cicd-deploy-sa.yaml \
    | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f -
  # Cross-namespace RBAC for pocket-id-client-seed to also patch website-secrets (T001435)
  envsubst "\$WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE \$WEBSITE_NAMESPACE" < k3d/pocket-id-client-seed-website-rbac.yaml \
    | kubectl --context "$ENV_CONTEXT" apply -f -
  # NOTE: systemtest cleanup CronJobs removed in T002644 — their /sdlc/ routes
  # no longer exist in prod after SDLC-split (T002624).
fi

tasks.description: Sync alle DB-Passwörter aus workspace-secrets → PostgreSQL ALTER USER (ENV=dev|mentolder|korczewski)
cmds_summary:
source scripts/env-resolve.sh "{{.ENV}}"
context_flag=""
[ "{{.ENV}}" != "dev" ] && context_flag="--context $ENV_CONTEXT"
NS="${WORKSPACE_NAMESPACE:-workspace}"

echo "Waiting for shared-db to be ready before syncing DB passwords..."
kubectl $context_flag rollout status deployment/shared-db -n "$NS" --timeout=120s

echo "Syncing DB passwords from ${NS}/workspace-secrets → shared-db ({{.ENV}})..."

nc_needs_restart=0
for user in pocket_id nextcloud vaultwarden website docuseal; do
  key="${user^^}_DB_PASSWORD"
  pw=$(kubectl $context_flag get secret workspace-secrets -n "$NS" \
    -o jsonpath="{.data.${key}}" 2>/dev/null | base64 -d)
  if [ -z "$pw" ]; then
    echo "  SKIP ${user}: ${key} not found in workspace-secrets"
    continue
  fi

  # Nextcloud persists its DB password inside config.php on the PVC.
  # When the secret rotates (e.g. sealed-secrets reseal), the PVC copy
  # drifts — and the Nextcloud bootstrap opens a DB connection before
  # `occ` can run, so `occ config:system:set dbpassword` cannot recover
  # the state (this is the PR #282 outage shape). Patch config.php
  # in-place via PHP (stdin-piped, special chars safe) BEFORE ALTER
  # USER; if we actually changed it, rollout-restart nextcloud after
  # the loop so it picks the file up cleanly.
  if [ "$user" = "nextcloud" ]; then
    nc_pod=$(kubectl $context_flag -n "$NS" get pod -l app=nextcloud \
      -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$nc_pod" ]; then
      current_pw=$(kubectl $context_flag -n "$NS" exec "$nc_pod" -c nextcloud -- \
        php -r 'if(!file_exists("/var/www/html/config/config.php")){exit;}$CONFIG=[];include "/var/www/html/config/config.php";echo $CONFIG["dbpassword"]??"";' 2>/dev/null 2>&1 || true)
      if [ -z "$current_pw" ]; then
        echo "  nextcloud-config.php: config.php missing or malformed — skipping in-place sync"
      elif [ "$current_pw" = "$pw" ]; then
        echo "  nextcloud-config.php: already in sync"
      else
        echo "  nextcloud-config.php: dbpassword drifted → patching in-place"
        if printf '%s' "$pw" | kubectl $context_flag -n "$NS" exec -i "$nc_pod" -c nextcloud -- \
          php -r '$p="/var/www/html/config/config.php";$CONFIG=[];include $p;if(!isset($CONFIG["dbpassword"])){fwrite(STDERR,"refusing to write: existing config has no dbpassword\n");exit(1);}$CONFIG["dbpassword"]=stream_get_contents(STDIN);file_put_contents($p,"<?php\n\$CONFIG = ".var_export($CONFIG,true).";\n");' 2>&1 | sed "s/^/    /"; then
          nc_needs_restart=1
        else
          echo "    (config.php patch failed — falling through to ALTER USER; pod may need manual repair)"
        fi
      fi
    else
      echo "  nextcloud-config.php: no nextcloud pod found — skipping config.php sync (ALTER USER below may strand the pod until config.php is repaired)"
    fi
  fi

  kubectl $context_flag exec -n "$NS" deployment/shared-db -- \
    psql -U postgres -c "ALTER USER ${user} WITH PASSWORD '$(printf "%s" "$pw" | sed "s/'/''/g")';" 2>&1 \
    | sed "s/^/  ${user}: /"
done

if [ "$nc_needs_restart" = 1 ]; then
  echo "Restarting nextcloud to pick up patched config.php..."
  kubectl $context_flag -n "$NS" rollout restart deployment/nextcloud
  kubectl $context_flag -n "$NS" rollout status deployment/nextcloud --timeout=180s
fi
echo "✓ DB passwords synced (ENV={{.ENV}}, ns=$NS)"
